# r5 — Payable

## What this measures

An agent that can open a checkout but not pay is a window-shopper. Probes
the payment surfaces of the agentic payment stack: payment handlers in the
UCP profile, ACP delegated payment, AP2 mandate signalling, and an HTTP 402
machine-payment surface (MPP or x402). This observes advertised wire structure,
not cryptographic validity, facilitator support, settlement, or full conformance.

## Sub-checks

| Sub-check | Pass when | Weight | Fix skill |
|-----------|-----------|-------:|-----------|
| payment handlers declared | UCP profile carries `payment_handlers` (or payment config) | 2 | `ucp-agentic-commerce:ucp-payment-handlers` |
| AP2 mandates signalled | profile mentions ap2/mandate extension | 1 | `ap2-agentic-payments:ap2-setup` |
| ACP delegate_payment surface | `{api_base_url}/agentic_commerce/delegate_payment` answers (distinguishable from the catch-all baseline; deep: returns delegated_payment shape or ACP-shaped validation error) | 2 | `acp-agentic-commerce:acp-delegated-payment` |
| HTTP 402 surface (MPP or x402) | a sampled path answers 402 with a supported, structurally valid challenge envelope | 1 | Detected protocol: `stripe-mpp:mpp-server-middleware` or `x402-agentic-payments:x402-http-payments`; unknown/mixed: `commerce-readiness:readiness-fix-plan` |

## N/A condition

The site does not transact (r4 fully N/A).

## Fix guidance

Payment handler declaration is configuration, not code — start there.
Delegated payment and AP2 mandates are deeper builds; read
`ap2-agentic-payments:ap2-agent-authorization` before designing either, and
use `acp-agentic-commerce:acp-delegate-authentication` when 3DS enters the
flow.

The bounded scan checks `/api/paid`, `/api/premium`, `/paid`, `/x402`, and
`/api`. An unrelated 402 body earns no point and does not stop the scan.
Legacy x402 v1 is identified but does not satisfy the v2 envelope check.
Both protocols together still earn at most one point. No support observed on
these paths does not establish absence elsewhere. MPP method-specific semantics,
JCS serialization, and challenge authentication are outside this surface check.
TAP is tested locally through its conformance plugin, not inferred from public keys.
